evidence_quotes.O: I have been an amateur photographer for many years. My favorite type of photography is "nature", especially birds.
evidence_quotes.C: But I wanted to plan a 600 mile trip myself using it's internal maps and waypoints. But I tried a local test first.
evidence_quotes.E: I discovered satellite joy! WOW! No commercials! Lotsa stations, including stand up comedy! I was hooked.
evidence_quotes.A: No more Linksys or Cisco for me. I have had them many many years, and like all things, cost goes up, quality goes down.
evidence_quotes.N: Internal Digix5 processing is horrendous. You must use this camera at ISO 100 as much as possible.
